metadata.body:
Document that factories and builders returning instrumented library objects should expose the underlying library's application-facing type when it is the complete intended caller-facing contract. Apply the rule to RxJava's `TracedOnSubscribe.perSubscription()`:

```java
Observable.OnSubscribe<T> onSubscribe =
    TracedOnSubscribe.perSubscription(original, instrumenter, requestFactory);
Observable<T> observable = Observable.create(onSubscribe);
```

This changes the source and binary signature of an alpha API. Replace result declarations of `TracedOnSubscribe<T, REQUEST>` with `Observable.OnSubscribe<T>` and recompile consumers.

The convention does not apply to OpenTelemetry-defined types or SPIs. Concrete types required for supported setup or framework integration remain valid.
